description: deployment-config/v1 vectors for DaemonConfig (ADR-0049). Every `input` is the document text, byte for byte. `cases` pin the canonical resolved bytes and configDigest (BLAKE3-256 over them) under the named host; ExecutionDaemonConfig cases also pin the backend struct values the runtime library entry builds. Every `rejects` input is refused with the pinned field and reason (the first refusal in README order); `schemaRefuses` says whether the published JSON Schema refuses it too. `hosts` are the injected HostFacts each case resolves under (home, XDG_STATE_HOME, the platform data directory, the OS); a null member is unset.
